summary_oneline: NAV-7762's two Office Depot EcoTank end-cap planograms were delivered on the legacy pipeline; on the current cycle their rewritten rows exist only locally, untracked and unvalidated, and the report no longer shows the requested checks.

localization.role: pipeline constructor: resolves the type handler and refuses a row whose slots_definition is missing
loads the definition and is the only production caller of validate_zone_selectors
result contract: eight legacy keys plus additive keys, no markdown
type used by both rows; default perception_mode is cv, min_usable_shapes 1
per-row layout override: perception_mode (cv | llm_detector), roi_detection, roi_zone_labels
selector validation required for repeated zone kinds; not run by the migration preflight
dispatch of the six rule kinds available to a zone
'graphic is present'; unassessed (not failed) when visibility is unknown
backlit ON vs OFF: params.required on | off, penalty on mismatch
keyword-overlap visual check: the closest thing to 'correct image' for a zone
closed-vocabulary colour / finish check (FEAT-683)
zone-shelf score: presence / text / visual weights and the illumination multiplier
marks a zone-only run INCONCLUSIVE unless every listed rule was assessed
turns each unowned zone into a virtual shelf 'zone:<zone_id>' with level None
projects zone shelves into the legacy per-shelf result the report consumes
overall_compliant only when the assessment is complete and every shelf is compliant
migration preflight verdict used by the apply scripts and the migrate command
mechanical converter for promotional endcaps (one zone per legacy product)
emits an illumination binding only from illumination_required
reference images feed product identification only, never zones
asks the vision model for illumination only when the zone has an illumination binding
FlowTask consumer: raises ConfigError for a row without slots_definition; type from the row column
builds the report shown in Epson360: per shelf, tick only at score 1.0, no rule outcomes
git-ignored script holding the rewritten backlit row (3 zones, llm_detector, illumination on)
git-ignored script holding the rewritten not-backlit row (4 zones, illumination off)
per-config e2e runner that reads the active row from the ENV database
generic type tests; no fixture of either EcoTank row
the sanctioned migration procedure (preflight, export, convert, render, apply with confirmation)
precedent: a planogram row change committed as SQL with its feature

constraints.statement: A row must carry slots_definition: PlanogramCompliance.__init__ and the FlowTask component both refuse a legacy row before any image is processed.
constraints.implication: There is no fallback to the March configuration; production rows must be in the new format before (or together with) the new runtime.

constraints.statement: The planogram type is read from the planogram_type column of the row, never from slots_definition.meta.
constraints.implication: Any row artefact must set or verify the column value endcap_no_shelves_promotional; the apply scripts write only the meta copy.

constraints.statement: planogram_id differs between environments (9 and 3 in the exported database, 23 and 24 in the ticket's production logs); config_name is the only stable key.
constraints.implication: Every SQL statement and fixture must be keyed by config_name.

constraints.statement: Configuration rows are hand-applied data changes by policy: FEAT-612 and FEAT-683 exclude automatic SQL application, and the migrate command requires an explicit confirmation naming the target database for its two writing steps.
constraints.implication: The feature can ship reviewed artefacts and a procedure; it must not write to dev or production on its own.

constraints.statement: check_row does not run validate_zone_selectors; only the pipeline constructor does, and both apply scripts gate their UPDATE on check_row alone.
constraints.implication: A row can pass preflight and still fail at construction; both EcoTank rows have repeated zone kinds and therefore depend on selectors.

constraints.statement: For a zone-only row every required zone needs a mandatory zone_present binding, and one unassessed mandatory rule makes the run INCONCLUSIVE, which can never be compliant.
constraints.implication: Each additional mandatory rule (text, visual, illumination, appearance) is another way for a correct display to end not compliant.

constraints.statement: No rule compares a zone with a reference image; reference images feed product identification only.
constraints.implication: 'Top Graphic is correct image' can only be approximated by text, keyword visual features, illumination and appearance unless a new capability is built.

constraints.statement: Zone shelves are projected with level None: the default threshold and default weights apply, not the per-level 0.95 / 0.9 thresholds of the legacy rows.
constraints.implication: Compliance cut-offs for these planograms changed silently with the migration and need an explicit decision.

constraints.statement: The report a user reads is built in the FlowTask repository, per shelf: a shelf is ticked only at score 1.0, rule outcomes go only to the JSON report, the projection never fills text_compliance_results, and products_found is off for this type by documented policy.
constraints.implication: Naming the ticket's four checks in the UI needs a change in the projection, in the FlowTask renderer, or in both; the second is a cross-repository change.

constraints.statement: The eight legacy result keys must be preserved.
constraints.implication: Any reporting change has to be additive.

constraints.statement: No planogram source differs between origin/main and origin/dev; the 2026-10-15 fixes are first tagged in 1.2.3 and the optional-zone scoring fix in 1.2.5.
constraints.implication: What is pending for production is data and deployment; the worker needs ai-parrot-pipelines 1.2.5 or later.

constraints.statement: The type defaults to cv perception and the converter never sets llm_detector, never emits appearance, and emits illumination only from illumination_required.
constraints.implication: The mechanical conversion cannot produce these rows; they have to be authored by hand and reviewed.

constraints.statement: No test or fixture exercises either configuration; the per-config e2e runner reads the row from whichever database ENV selects.
constraints.implication: A regression on these displays is only caught by a manual run; a committed fixture with expected outcomes is missing.

hypotheses.statement: The March deliverable cannot run on the current runtime, and its replacement was never delivered: the rewritten rows for both planograms exist only in a local database and in git-ignored scripts, with no tracked artefact, no retained validation result and no recorded path to production.
hypotheses.reasoning: Direct reads show both the pipeline and FlowTask reject a row without slots_definition, and that the only new-format versions of the two rows are local. The rewrite (2026-10-15), release 1.2.3 (2026-10-16) and the reopen (2026-10-21) line up, and no code changed in between. What keeps this at medium: nothing records why the ticket was reopened, and no database was contacted, so the state of production is unknown.
hypotheses.next_probe: On the production database (read-only): SELECT config_name, planogram_id, planogram_type, slots_definition IS NOT NULL AS migrated, updated_at FROM troc.planograms_configurations WHERE config_name LIKE 'epson_depot_ecotank_%backlit%'; and check the ai-parrot-pipelines version installed on the Epson360 FlowTask worker.

hypotheses.statement: On the new cycle the two planograms no longer report what the ticket asks: the UI report names zones instead of the four requested checks, shows no text or product evidence, can print a cross on a compliant zone, and the rewritten rows fail photos on rules the ticket never requested.
hypotheses.reasoning: Every element is read from code or from the row scripts. F032 shows the empty product list is documented policy, so part of this is by design rather than a defect. It has not been observed in a run: no result of the rewritten rows is kept (F021).
hypotheses.next_probe: With the local database up, run `python examples/planogram/e2e/main.py epson_depot_ecotank_backlit_planogram_config --output-dir <new dir>` and the not-backlit equivalent, then read the per-zone status, score and assessment_status for each of the 12 photos.

hypotheses.statement: The Backlit planogram never produced a correct result: the run attached when the ticket was resolved scored 32 % with zero detections, and in the type's default cv mode a lit lightbox can satisfy the poster profile so the ROI step is skipped.
hypotheses.reasoning: The 32 % run is in the ticket's own log (source), and the cv-mode behaviour is stated in the type defaults and in the comment of the backlit script. The rewritten backlit row already sets llm_detector (F002), so if that row is what runs, this cause is addressed; whether it is what runs in production is unknown.
hypotheses.next_probe: Check epson.compliance_photo_reports for planogram 'EcoTank End Cap Backlit' since 2026-03-17: share of rows with overall_compliant = false and their detection_source.

unknowns.question: How strict should the two planograms be? The ticket lists presence of three graphics plus 'Top Graphic is correct image'; the rewritten rows make text, visual, illumination and appearance rules mandatory on every zone, and split the Not Backlit top into a header strip and the Shaq panel.

recommended_next_command.rationale: The user's answers closed the three scope forks (ticket-minimal rules, no artwork-comparison rule, report itemised in both repositories) and confirmed the reopen reason and the production state; localization is high-confidence. Overall confidence stays medium because the git research was truncated and no run of the rows was observed.

before_qa.rationale: Medium confidence, truncated git research and three open product decisions spanning two repositories.

meta.notes: Follow-ups answerable by more research, not by the user: (1) history of the slots_definition requirement and of _create_markdown_report in the flowtask repository (git budget exhausted); (2) a run of the rewritten rows on the 12 local photos (needs the local database up); (3) where the Epson360 'Planogram Type' name comes from (not in this repository).
